scenes.score_intent: Uneasy intimate confessional underscore; low sustained tension that supports denial of madness without overpowering speech
scenes.timing: Enter under first candle flutter; hold sparse through monologue; slight swell on 'hearken' then settle
scenes.diegetic_sound: Single candle flame flutter; distant house creak; Narrator's quick breath; faint death-watch ticking in the walls
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: No music stings on cuts; no exterior street noise; keep room dead quiet under his voice so hearing acuity reads
alternatives: Dry room tone only with tick and breath
Very low bowed-string drone under last line only

scenes.score_intent: Quiet dread and obsession; motive reveal stays hushed and predatory
scenes.timing: Soft pad under doorway presence; thin hold through V.O. eye reveal; no hit on cut
scenes.diegetic_sound: Soft latch click; careful floorboard weight under Narrator's step; Old Man's slow sleep breathing; closed-lantern hush
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: No heartbeat yet; no loud hinges; exclude any neighbour or street sound

scenes.score_intent: Methodical suspense; cunning patience over seven nights compressed
scenes.timing: Pulse lightly with each cautious advance; freeze score when he freezes on hinge threat; thin ray moment nearly dry
scenes.diegetic_sound: Latch turn; hinges threaten a creak then stop; slow head-and-lantern slide; soft scrape of lantern lid; single thin ray (no electrical hum)
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: Kill all non-essential ambience during freeze; no Old Man snore spikes; no music swell on ray
alternatives: Sparse clock-like wood ticks matching caution

scenes.score_intent: False daylight warmth and ease; ironic normalcy after nights of stalking
scenes.timing: Brighter open tone on entry; gentle resolve under clasp; short scene keep light
scenes.diegetic_sound: Shutters rattle lightly; cheerful footsteps on boards; Narrator's hearty calling voice; Old Man weak murmur and bed shift
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: No horror drones; no ticking heart; no night insects; keep morning domestic only
alternatives: Brief major-key woodwind color under greeting then out

scenes.score_intent: Peak suspense and held breath; triumph into terror standoff for the long hour
scenes.timing: Creep under slow latch; micro-hit on metallic slip; sustain near-silence through frozen hour; low well on stifled groan
scenes.diegetic_sound: Almost-inaudible chuckle; bedclothes sudden shift; sharp metallic slip of thumb on tin fastening; death-watch ticks in wall; long held breaths; stifled groan of mortal terror from bed
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: After slip, strip to ticks and breath only for the stillness stretch; no score melody during hour freeze; no exterior knock yet
alternatives: Low irregular pulse under groan only

scenes.score_intent: Fury and climax kill; heartbeat as driving diegetic engine then merciful stop
scenes.timing: Introduce muffled-watch heart under open-eye stare; accelerate through build; hard impact on yell/shriek/bed slam; decay muffled beats many minutes then hard stop into silence
scenes.diegetic_sound: Soft scrape of lantern lid; low dull quick heart sound like watch in cotton rising louder; Narrator scarcely breathing; loud yell; Old Man single shriek; bed frame slam; muffled frantic beating beneath bed slowing to cease; hand-on-chest silence so complete candle seems loud
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: After final cease, leave true silence before V.O. confirmation; no triumphant fanfare; officers and street still absent
alternatives: Heart only diegetic with no score under kill
Low percussion double of heart then cut with cease

scenes.score_intent: Grim industrious aftermath then sudden external threat; satisfaction undercut by knock
scenes.timing: Sparse work rhythm under dismember and planks; brief dark humor color on laugh; bell then knock punctuate end
scenes.diegetic_sound: Muffled saw and knife work; planks pry up and settle back cunningly; tub liquid catch; low satisfied ha-ha laugh; distant four o'clock bell; firm knocking at street door below
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: No heart under floor yet; no police voices until S8; keep work sounds contained not splattery
alternatives: Dry carpentry Foley only until bell
Single low piano hit on knock

scenes.score_intent: Polite official calm and false relief; light heart before return to chamber
scenes.timing: Open with night air on door; neutral underscore under introductions; stay restrained
scenes.diegetic_sound: Door latch; night air; three pairs of boots on threshold; Officer Reynolds calm speech; Narrator light smile and welcome lines
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: No heart-beat; no chamber ticks bleeding in; no ominous sting on officers' faces
alternatives: Thin civil string pad under dialogue

scenes.score_intent: Catastrophic guilt crescendo; subjective heart overwhelms polite chat into confession scream then hard cut silence
scenes.timing: Ease under chair settle and chat; high thin ringing enters; morph to watch-in-cotton heart rising under talk; escalate with pace grate and rave; maximum on shrieked confession; abrupt total cut to silence on final beat
scenes.diegetic_sound: Chairs scrape; pleasant low officer conversation and smiles; floorboard settle under Narrator's chair; high thin ringing sharpening; low dull quick heart sound rising steadily; Narrator quickened speech then high-key argument; heavy boot strides; chair legs grate on boards; ragged breath foam rave swear; confession shriek ringing off walls; heart thundering; candle gutter; abrupt silence
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: Officers must seem not to hear the heart until confession; no non-diegetic choir; after shriek cut all sound clean for end button
alternatives: Heart and scrape only after ringing with score stripped
End on dry shriek echo into black silence without tail music
